name: Structure
title: 安全线索，从内部协作开始
en: INSIDE THE WATCH. BUILT FOR AWARENESS.

lines.zh: SoundBridge，为听障人士设计的环境感知手表。先从它的内部看起。
lines.en: SoundBridge is an environmental awareness watch for deaf and hard-of-hearing people. Let's look inside.

lines.zh: 四个麦克风接收声音，处理电路分析信号，显示模组和触觉马达传达提醒。
lines.en: Four microphones capture sound. The processor analyzes signals. The display and haptic actuator deliver cues.

lines.zh: 这些部件如何协作，把声音变成可感知的安全线索？
lines.en: How do these components turn sound into perceptible safety cues?

name: Logic
title: 从环境声音，到可感知的线索
en: SOUND → ANALYSIS → A CUE SHE CAN FEEL AND SEE

lines.zh: 四路麦克风同步收音，把声音转成数字信号。
lines.en: Four microphones capture sound together and convert it into digital signals.

lines.zh: 一条路径提取频谱特征，识别车铃或鸣笛；另一条比较到达时差，估算来向。
lines.en: One path extracts spectral features to classify bells or horns. Another compares arrival times to estimate direction.

lines.zh: 两路结果汇合：振动引起注意，表盘用图标、文字和角度，提示往哪里看。
lines.en: The results combine: vibration gets attention; icons, text and angles show where to look.

name: Opening
title: 让听障人士，及时感知路上的线索
en: ENVIRONMENTAL AWARENESS FOR DEAF AND HARD-OF-HEARING PEOPLE

lines.zh: 现在，回到小林的一天。她是一位听障人士，正在独自出行。
lines.en: Now, back to Xiaolin's day. She is deaf or hard of hearing and is travelling independently.

lines.zh: 让我们看看，腕上的线索如何帮助她留意路况。
lines.en: Let's see how cues on her wrist help her stay aware of the road.

name: Approach
title: 身后的车铃，抵达手腕
en: A BELL BEHIND HER. A CUE ON HER WRIST.

lines.zh: 骑行者从左后方接近，车铃响起。
lines.en: A cyclist approaches from behind on the left and rings a bell.

lines.zh: 四个麦克风接收声音，识别车铃后，发出三次短振。
lines.en: Four microphones capture the sound. Recognizing the bicycle bell triggers three short pulses.

lines.zh: 三次短振引起注意，小林抬腕查看类别和来向。
lines.en: Three short pulses get her attention. Xiaolin checks the sound class and direction on her wrist.

lines.zh: 她转头确认，靠边让行，等骑行者通过。
lines.en: She looks around, moves aside and lets the cyclist pass.

name: Array
title: 四路信号，共同判断来向

lines.zh: 比较四个麦克风的到达时差，可以估算声音来向。
lines.en: Comparing arrival times at four microphones helps estimate direction.

lines.zh: 骑行者从左后方经过左前方，表盘角度与方位标记同步变化。
lines.en: As the cyclist moves from rear left to front left, the dial angle and pointer move together.

name: Crossing
title: 路口的鸣笛，提醒她留意车辆
en: NOTICE THE VEHICLE AT THE CROSSING.

lines.zh: 来到路口，一辆车从右前方驶来。
lines.en: At a crossing, a vehicle approaches from the front right.

lines.zh: 识别鸣笛后，两次长振提醒她，表盘显示类别和来向。
lines.en: Recognizing the horn triggers two long pulses. The dial shows the sound class and direction.

lines.zh: 收到振动后，她抬腕查看，在路缘内停步观察。
lines.en: Feeling the vibration, she checks her watch and stops before the curb.

name: Wait
title: 先观察，等车辆通过
en: LOOK FIRST. LET THE VEHICLE PASS.

lines.zh: 看清车辆的行进方向，她留在安全的位置等待。
lines.en: She checks the vehicle direction and waits in a safe position.

lines.zh: 等车辆通过，确认道路情况，再继续前行。
lines.en: After it passes, she checks the road and continues.

name: Bearing
title: 类别与方向，让提醒更清楚
en: KNOW THE SOUND. UNDERSTAND ITS DIRECTION.

lines.zh: 看这里，表盘高亮角度与方向箭头，说明声音从哪里来。
lines.en: Here, the dial highlights the angle and directional arrow to show where the sound comes from.

lines.zh: 触觉引起注意，视觉补充信息，最后由她观察和判断。
lines.en: Touch gets her attention. Visual cues add context. She observes and decides.

name: Personalize
title: 在安全位置，调整适合自己的提醒
en: PERSONALIZE THE CUE IN A SAFE PLACE.

lines.zh: 在安全位置停稳后，小林调整振动强度和文字大小。
lines.en: Stopped in a safe place, Xiaolin adjusts vibration strength and text size.

lines.zh: 让提醒清楚而舒适，后续行程沿用她的设置。
lines.en: Clear, comfortable cues continue with her chosen settings.

name: RearAlert
title: 再次接近，也能及时察觉

lines.zh: 另一位骑行者从右后方接近，手表再次识别车铃。
lines.en: Another cyclist approaches from behind on the right. The watch identifies the bell.

lines.zh: 短振与右后方提示出现，小林抬腕，转头观察。
lines.en: Short pulses and a rear-right cue appear. Xiaolin checks her wrist and looks around.

lines.zh: 她让出空间，保持对周围的警觉，等待对方通过。
lines.en: She makes space, stays aware of her surroundings and lets the rider pass.

name: Closing
title: 让听障人士，更从容地出行

lines.zh: 安全感，来自及时的线索，也来自自己的判断。
lines.en: Confidence comes from timely cues and her own judgment.

lines.zh: SoundBridge，为听障人士设计的环境感知手表。
lines.en: SoundBridge. An environmental awareness watch for deaf and hard-of-hearing people.
